summary: feat(settings): explain unusable passkey wraps on the password fallback
description:
Because:

* A Sync passkey with a wrap could fall back to the password page
  with no explanation
* Nothing recorded why a passkey sign-in fell back to the password page

This commit:

* Fetches the wrap even without PRF output, so no_prf is told apart from no_wrap
* Passes the fallback cause to the password page in router state
* Shows a banner with a Learn more link for no_prf and unwrap_failed
* Adds a cause extra to passkey_enter_password.view and a banner view event
* Stashes opt-in material only when the PRF output is usable

Closes #FXA-14797
